title: SynTab-GRC: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: A Master's thesis framework that benchmarks statistical, GAN-based, and VAE-based synthetic tabular data generators across fidelity, utility, privacy, fairness, and sustainability, producing an audit-ready GRC scorecard. It trains SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata, and evaluates outputs with sdmetrics' QualityReport.
evidence: src/config.py:20-24 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and defines MODELS_CONFIG using them
